console.label: Power on
console.prompt: Turn it on and show the screen or power light

console.label: Launch a game
console.prompt: Start a game and show it running on screen
console.expect: a game running on the display

console.label: Press every button
console.prompt: Press each button while the screen shows it responding

console.label: Show the serial label
console.prompt: Show the serial number label up close

console.label: Show all sides
console.prompt: Turn it slowly to show every side
console.expect: all sides, no major damage hidden

phone.label: Power on
phone.prompt: Turn the phone on and show the lock screen

phone.label: Model and storage
phone.prompt: Open Settings, then About, and show the model and storage
phone.expect: an About screen with model and storage visible

phone.label: Battery health
phone.prompt: Open Settings, then Battery, then Battery Health, and show it
phone.expect: a battery health percentage on screen

phone.label: IMEI
phone.prompt: Dial *#06# and show the IMEI on screen

phone.label: Screen has no cracks
phone.prompt: Show the screen at an angle under light, edge to edge
phone.expect: a screen with no visible cracks

phone.label: Account signed out
phone.prompt: Open Settings and show that no account is signed in at the top
phone.expect: no Apple ID or Google account shown as signed in

laptop.label: Power on
laptop.prompt: Turn it on and show it booting or at the login screen

laptop.label: Model and specs
laptop.prompt: Open About This Mac or System Information and show it
laptop.expect: a system info screen with model and specs

laptop.label: Keyboard works
laptop.prompt: Open a text box and type the alphabet

laptop.label: No dead pixels
laptop.prompt: Show a full white screen, then a full black screen
laptop.expect: an even screen with no dead pixels or lines

laptop.label: Show all sides
laptop.prompt: Close the lid and turn it slowly to show every side
laptop.expect: all sides, no major damage hidden

other.label: Power on
other.prompt: Turn it on and show that it works
other.expect: device visibly powered on or working

other.label: Show the serial label
other.prompt: Show the serial number or model label
other.expect: a readable serial or model label

other.label: Show all sides
other.prompt: Turn it slowly to show every side
other.expect: all sides, no major damage hidden
